evidence.summary: A 5-fold cross-validation sweep using only the 90 Round-1 and Round-2 observations selected the base Extra Trees surrogate.
The frozen model was evaluated on 80 previously unseen Round-4 observations.
Controlled observations showed a positive relationship between age and score in tested regions.
Controlled observations showed a positive relationship between prior visits and score in tested regions.
A controlled configuration showed that reducing years_registered from 40 to 0 increased score by approximately 0.10.
Controlled observations showed substantial, context-dependent score changes associated with comorbidity_ratio.
R1+R2 contain zero DECLINE observations, so an exact hidden decision boundary cannot be learned from the training labels. 0.6150 is reported only as a surrogate decision cutoff.
